Recommend a frozen snapshot of the currently loaded database plus a small, reviewed query corpus. Run each candidate algorithm against the same snapshot through `EntitySearchService`, so SQL candidate selection, alias scoring and MP/funder merging all participate.

Keep two separate records:

- Baseline output records what today's algorithm returns. Diff added, removed and moved entities, plus changes in `match_source`. Changes require review; baseline equality should not define quality.
- Reviewed expectations record which entities should appear within the first few results, which should rank ahead of others, and which must be absent. Put currently failing typo cases here as explicit known failures, so today's misses do not become accepted expectations.

Each case needs the query, strictness, requested limit, expected entity identities and a short reason. Start with canonical names, aliases, abbreviations, punctuation, misspellings, ambiguous names, mixed MP/funder results and nonsense queries. Avoid asserting every rank or exact floating-point score unless the case specifically tests ordering or a threshold.

Identity and ordering details matter:

- Members have portable `parliament_member_id` identities. Funder API IDs are database UUIDs. Preserve UUIDs in the frozen snapshot; for portable fixtures, resolve labels through `resolution_identity_id` where available. The loader preserves UUIDs when upserting an existing resolver identity, but a fresh database generates new UUIDs.
- Both repositories break score ties using database UUIDs, so rebuilding data can change equal-score ordering.
- `max_entries` applies separately to MPs and funders; the merge currently has no combined truncation. Treat combined result limits as reviewed product expectations, not assumptions.

Useful pointers:

- [entity_search.rs](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/domain/services/entity_search.rs:42) owns the real search composition.
- [funder.rs](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/outbound/funder.rs:18) scores canonical names and aliases.
- [parliament_member.rs](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/outbound/parliament_member.rs:39) scores MPs.
- [integration.rs](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/tests/integration.rs:24) already verifies canonical identity and alias provenance through HTTP.
- [declaration_loading.rs](/Users/jamie/development/exposed/exposed/src/lib/outbound/declaration_loading.rs:585) upserts funders by resolver identity.

Use the full snapshot for algorithm comparison and retain smaller SQLx fixtures for routine CI. Record the snapshot fingerprint, PostgreSQL/extension versions and algorithm revision alongside each result report.
